annotations.title: Ask ManyLives to API-ify a website

description: Free to ask: request that one public website or registry be turned into a clean JSON endpoint you can call. Each request is checked (no logins, CAPTCHAs or personal data; robots.txt respected); if accepted, a flat US$10 setup fee, then pay per call.

calls_per_day.description: Roughly how many calls a day.

example_inputs.description: What you would pass in, e.g. a tracking number.

max_usd_per_call.description: The most you would pay per call, in US dollars.

url.description: The page or site to API-ify (https://...).

wants.description: Which data you need out of it.
